notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 0.1.1.0 - December 9, 2022
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vyk9-h3TQ3g;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Bugs and Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Crash on Final Stage completion
[*] Fixed Rank being awarded after completing the final stage
[*] Death animation adjusted to face the direction the character was facing at the time of death
[/list]
[i]Other minor fixes and adjustments, Like stage Personal Best Saving and hazard flash speed, etc.[/i]

[h3]Stage Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redesigned Parts of [i][b]R0-5383D CPU [/b][/i]that did not play well or were tedious
[*] Redesigned the Initial segment of [i][b]Modular G8[/b][/i] prior to the first check point as it was confusing or tedious
[*] Complete Redesign of [i][b]UPS Type - 2[/b][/i] as the stage had not been revamped in over 4 years
[*] Added new stage Element, One way platforms that [i][b]Frame[/b][/i] can jump through but can also stand on or wall slide on the flat face of it
[*] Minor adjustments to other stages to make sections in other stages more player friendly
[/list]
